data.title: Does enough capital exist to finance everyone’s ambitious AI spending plans?
data.description: Investing.com -- Meta last week said that recent capital raises by peers such as Alphabet and SpaceX, and expected fundraising by Anthropic and OpenAI, have created an “increasingly challenging fundraising environment,” raising questions over whether enough capital exists to fund AI spending plans.
